prompt: Find and prepare a list of vendors who manufacture or sell battery recycling equipment in the USA
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 largely lists battery recyclers/technology operators (e.g., Li-Cycle, Redwood Materials) rather than clear vendors that manufacture or sell recycling equipment, so it drifts from the equipment-seller requirement. Candidate 2 provides a list of vendors, but many entries are not clearly verifiable as real equipment manufacturers/sellers, making it more prone to dubious or fabricated specifics. Candidate 3 best matches the prompt by including multiple established recycling-equipment manufacturers (e.g., Herbold USA, Eriez, Steinert US, Shred-Tech, American Pulverizer) that plausibly sell equipment used in battery recycling, though it still includes some non-equipment actors. Candidate 4 mixes a few plausible equipment companies with several that are mainly battery recycling programs or services (e.g., Call2Recycle, TerraCycle, Reclay), reducing alignment with “manufacture or sell battery recycling equipment.”
